spans.s:
उचथ उचथ, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वच्), Ved.
verse, praise.

उचथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. deserving praise; (अस्),
m., N. of an Āṅgirasa, author of some hymns of the
Ṛg-veda.

उच्च उच्च, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. 1. उद् with
च fr. rt. अञ्च्), high, lofty, elevated; tall; deep; high-
sounding, loud, pronounced with the Udātta accent;
intense, violent; (अस्), m. the apex of the orbit of a
planet; [cf. Hib. uchdan, ‘a hillock;’ Cambro-Brit.
uched, ‘cleve.’]
—उच्च-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, highest.
—उच्च-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, higher, more lofty.
—उच्च-
तरु, उस्, m. the cocoa-nut tree; any lofty tree.
—उच्च-ता, f. or उच्च-त्व, अम्, n. height, superi-
ority.
—उच्च-ताल, अम्, n. music and dancing at
feasts, drinking parties, &c.
—उच्च-देव, अस्, m. an
epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
—उच्च-देवता, f. time
personified, chronos.
—उच्च-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of
Śākya-muni as teacher of the gods among the Tuṣitas,
q. v.
—उच्च-नीच, अस्, आ, अम्, high and low, varie-
gated, heterogeneous; (अम्), n. the upper and lower
station of the planets; change of accent.
—उच्च-
पद, अम्, n. a high situation, a high office.
—उच्-
च-भाषण, अम्, n. speaking aloud.
—उच्च-भा-
षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking with a loud voice, shouting,
brawling.
—उच्च-ललाटा or -इका, f. a woman with a
high or projecting forehead.
—उच्चावच, अस्, आ, अम्
(fr. उच्च = उद् + च and अव + च?), high and low,
great and small, variegated, heterogeneous; various,
multiform; uneven, irregular, undulating.

उच्चा, ind., Ved. above (in heaven), from above,
upwards; उच्चा कृ, to carry upwards.
—उच्चा-चक्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a wheel above (epithet of a
well).
—उच्चा-बुध्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the
bottom upwards.
उच्चकैस्, ind. excessively lofty; tall; loud.

उच्चक् उच्-चक् (उद्-चक्), cl. 1. P. A. चकति,
-ते, -कितुम्, to look up at, behold.

उच्चक्षुस् उच्-चक्षुस् (उद्-च˚), उस्, उस्, उस्,
whose eyes are directed upwards.

उच्चघन उच्चघन, अम्, n. laughter in the
mind not expressed in the countenance.

उच्चट् उच्-चट् (उद्-चट्), cl. 1. P. -चटति, -टि-
तुम्, to go away, disappear; Caus. P. -चाटयति,
-यितुम्, to drive away, expel, scare.

उच्-चाटन, अम्, n. eradicating (as a plant), ex-
pulsion; ruining (an adversary), causing a person to
quit his occupation by means of magical incantations,
exciting disgust for one's profession.
उच्-चाटनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be driven away.
उच्-चाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven away.

उच्चटा उच्चटा, f. (perhaps connected with
उच्च or in some sense fr. उच्-चट् above), pride,
arrogance; habit, usage; N. of different plants, a
species of cyperus, a kind of garlic, Abrus Precatorius,
Flacourtia Cataphracta.

उच्चण्ड उच्-चण्ड (उद्-च˚), अस्, आ, अम्, quick,
expeditious; passionate, violent; hanging down.

उच्चन्द्र उच्-चन्द्र (उद्-च˚), अस्, m. the moon-
less period of the night, the last watch of the night.

उच्चर् उच्-चर् (उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रि-
तुम् (ep. sometimes -चर्तुम्), Ved. -रितवे or -वै,
-रसे, -रध्यै, to go upwards, ascend, rise (as the
sun), issue forth, go forth; to rise (as the voice); to
let the contents (of anything) issue out, to empty the
body by evacuations; to emit (sounds), utter, pro-
nounce; to quit, leave; to sin against, to be unfaith-
ful to a husband; to transgress against: Caus. -चार-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to go forth, to evacuate the
body by excretion, to discharge feces, to emit, to
cause to sound, utter, pronounce, declare.

उच्-चरण, अम्, n. going up or out, uttering,
articulating.

उच्-चारण, अम्, n. pronunciation, articulation, enun-
ciation; making audible.
—उच्चारण-ज्ञ, अस्, m. a
linguist, one skilled in utterances or sounds.
—उच्-
चारण-स्थान, अम्, n. the part of the throat whence
certain sounds such as nasals, gutturals &c. proceed.
—उच्चारणार्थ (˚ण-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, useful for pro-
nunciation; necessary for pronunciation, a redundant
letter &c. only used to make pronunciation easy.

उच्-चरण्य, nom. P. -चरण्यति, -यितुम्, to move
out, stretch out to.

उच्-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up or out, risen;
uttered, articulated; (अम्), n. excrement, dung.

उच्-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, pronounced, uttered, arti-
culated; having excrements.

उच्-चार, अस्, m. feces, excrement; discharge; pro-
nunciation, utterance.
उच्-चारक, अस्, आ, अम्, pronouncing, making audible.
उच्-चारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pronounced.
1. उच्-चार्य, ind. having spoken, uttered.

2. उच्-चार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken, to be pro-
nounced.

उच्-चार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being uttered or pro-
nounced.

उच्चल् उच्-चल् (उद्-चल्), cl. 1. P. -चलति, -लि-
तुम्, to go or move away from; to free one's self
from, loosen one's self from.
उच्-चल, अम्, n. the mind, the understanding.
उच्-चलन, अम्, n. going off or out, moving away.
उच्-चलित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up or out, winnowed.

उच्-चय, अस्, m. gathering, picking up from the
ground; adding to, annumeration; collection, heap,
plenty, multitude; the knot of the string or cloth
which fastens the lower garments round the loins tied
in front; the opposite side of a triangle.
—उच्चया-
पचय (˚य-अप्˚), औ, m. du. prosperity and decline,
rise and fall.
